evidence.snippet: To enable API access, ensure the intended user is assigned to a user group with the appropriate permissions.
If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager

decisions.reason: API access requires an admin to assign user-group permissions and enable the 'API' capability before a developer can obtain a key or token.

evidence.snippet: Navigate to Admin > User Management , select the relevant user group, go to Capabilities > Site Areas , and enable "API".

decisions.reason: No pricing/paid-plan gating is mentioned anywhere in the pages; the documented friction is admin-controlled user-group/API capability permissions.

evidence.snippet: The DealCloud MCP Server helps teams turn their DealCloud data into faster, higher-quality outcomes.
DealCloud provides a default MCP Server out-of-the-box without any configuration required.

decisions.reason: DealCloud itself documents and ships a default, out-of-the-box MCP Server, so this vendor-authored page is the official MCP server reference (the actual endpoint is tenant-specific, e.g. https://[tenant].my.intapp.com/mcp/celeste/DealCloud).
